ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course for students in the Springfield cohort begins August 23 and ends December 6. Class sessions will be held on Monday evenings from 6:00 to 8:50 PM on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. The classes will be held in the Visual and Performing Arts (VPA) building in room 150. The email address for the instructor is: mbolden@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $423.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
